## 2022-06-09 · reply to @Miles_Brundage

> @rokine40 @percyliang @CohereAI @OpenAI @AI21Labs @aidangomezzz @Udi73613335 Bias is hard as there are some tradeoffs, eg between (naive) means of filtering for data quality and how well the model works for underresourced communities, languages etc. I suspect fine tuning has more to offer + better pretraining data. More to say on evaluations specifically.

> @rokine40 @percyliang @CohereAI @OpenAI @AI21Labs @aidangomezzz @Udi73613335 We give some examples of policies/mitigations in the statement + more detail can be found in our respective documentation on our websites.
